description: This file defines HTTP handlers for managing the lifecycle of agents via a web API. It includes operations such as starting, stopping, retrieving status, listing running agents, and reconciliation. The handlers are implemented using the Gin framework and interact with services and storage components to perform their operations.

classes.name: LifecycleHandler
classes.description: A struct providing handlers for agent lifecycle management operations, holding references to storage and agent service components.

methods.name: NewLifecycleHandler
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new LifecycleHandler with specified storage and agent service dependencies.

methods.name: getAgentBaseURL
methods.description: Retrieves the stored base URL for an agent or constructs a localhost URL as fallback.

methods.name: buildEndpoints
methods.description: Creates a map of endpoint URLs for health, reasoners, and skills based on the agent's base URL.

methods.name: StartAgentHandler
methods.description: Handles the API request to start an agent with optional configuration parameters.

methods.name: StopAgentHandler
methods.description: Handles the API request to stop a currently running agent.

methods.name: GetAgentStatusHandler
methods.description: Returns the current status of a specified agent, including whether it is running, configuration status, and endpoints if applicable.

methods.name: ListRunningAgentsHandler
methods.description: Lists all currently running agents with metadata and endpoints.

methods.name: ReconcileAgentHandler
methods.description: Forces reconciliation of the agent's stored state with its actual process state.
